candidates.change_summary: Replace the return statement with a constant true so paused always returns true.
Replace the return statement with a constant false so paused always returns false.
Negate the returned value so paused returns !_paused.
Remove the assignment to lrtConfig so updateLRTConfig no longer changes the stored lrtConfig value.
Replace the lrtConfig assignment with an assignment of address(0) so the stored lrtConfig becomes the zero address.
Remove the zero-address check so updateLRTConfig accepts (and stores) address(0), which the original reverts on.
